messages:
alex: Hey folks — quick pre-cut sync. Proposing cut window: Fri Jun 12 22:00 UTC. Can everyone confirm availability? Need smoke owners, rollback lead, and SIG reps for DB/migration.

maria: I can do smoke for inference runtime (model + kv-cache tests). +1 for time.

sam: I’m oncall that day but can be standby for rollback. Prefer backup contact in case paging.

jen: I’ll cover migrations and DB read-only tests. +1.

dylan: I have a conflict until 22:30 UTC — can be backup after 23:00. If cut moves earlier it’s tough.

deploy-bot: CI: release-candidate build #482 passed integration tests. Artifacts at https://ci/redwood/builds/482 :rocket:

alex: Thanks — can we collect final roster by Thu 18:00 UTC? Agenda draft below, please edit inline or reply with owners.

alex: ```
Mini agenda (30m):
- Roll call & attendance (5m) — alex
- Smoke test owners confirm (5m) — maria/jen
- Canary plan & traffic shift (5m) — infra lead
- DB migration checklist & freeze window (5m) — jen
- Rollback criteria and rollback owner (5m) — sam/dylan
- Post-cut verification & who signs off (5m) — product rep
```

maria: Add: model quality quick eval — 3 sample prompts from prod promptsuite (3m)

sam: Rollback owner: sam, backup: dylan. I’ll add the rollback playbook snippet to the runbook.

jen: DB migration: we need to ensure read replicas are caught up — @dylan can you confirm replica lag check? :eyes: 

dylan: I’ll add a healthcheck to the smoke script: `curl -sS http://replica:8080/lag || echo 'lag-check-failed'`

oncall-sre: Note: ops SLO overlap with other release at 23:00 UTC — we prefer to avoid overlap but can cover if needed. :warning:

alex: If overlap risk persists we can shift to Sat 02:00 UTC — vote here :thumbsup: for shift, :thumbsdown: keep Fri 22:00.

maria: :thumbsup: shift to Sat 02:00 would be easier for model team.

sam: :thumbsdown: Fri still ok for me.

jen: :thumbsup: 

alex: OK — quorum leans to Sat 02:00. New proposed cut: Sat Jun 13 02:00 UTC. Final roster deadline Fri 20:00 UTC. I'll update calendar + runbook and ping stakeholders.

maria: Thanks — adding smoke checklist link: https://docs/redwood/smoke/checklists/release-inference

alex: One last ask: PM/product rep who signs off post-cut? @lee? Please confirm.

lee: I can sign off post-cut for product QA. Will join at 02:15 UTC if cut at 02:00.

alex: Great — marking this thread as final prep. @deploy-bot schedule reminder Fri 19:00 UTC for roster collection.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for Fri Jun 12 19:00 UTC (roster collection).

alex: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
